statement: The partition CDC obligation lane ships every owed obligation after its scan cursor, up to the existing count bound and a byte bound, as one ordered vector in one durable wave: draining a backlog of B owed rows takes at most ceil(B / bound) waves plus one per byte-bound split instead of B waves, while order within the partition, exact occurrence identity, the acknowledgement rule (a row is delivered only by a committed CDC_DELIVERED proposed after every current leaf returned a committed receipt for a vector containing it) and the idempotent recipient effect are unchanged.

constraints.statement: This is the bounded repair of the first measured cause of the open service quest fresh-formation-user-table-routability (owner (a), system-table-cache CDC delivery): on source ed708dfd the services lane delivered one event per wave, 120 of 134 events were committed before the previous one was answered, commit to first drive was 10.6 s at the median and 32.8 s at worst, and an uncontended lane on another node was saturated by wave time alone. Closing this quest does not claim the journey green: the node-wide propagation slot with its slicing, the partial-row cache write found in the same run, recipient isolation and a defined start position remain separate units.

The shipping bound decides how much one wave carries, never what may be delivered: a vector always holds at least one row, so a row larger than the byte bound ships alone and nothing is refused, split or dropped (cdc-owed-work-admission: no new payload, event or target-vector cap; W9 2 MiB and 65-target obligations stay deliverable). The count bound is the existing ACK_BATCH_MAX_EVENTS. The byte bound is derived from limits their owners already state for a message-group proposal and a router message and is imported from those owners; no new free-standing scalar is invented.

The durable subscriber contract becomes (events, deliveryContext) for every durable subscriber of the lane (propagation and live-query); there is no per-event adapter, alias, feature detection or compatibility branch, and no second delivery path. The non-durable user-table path is untouched.
A vector preserves every source occurrence in (log_index, ordinal) order with its own eventKey; distinct occurrences of one row are never merged, reordered or deduplicated by the sender.

No SQLite read is held across an await; the lane retains between attempts only positions and digests of its one pinned vector, never payloads; a retry after partial coverage presents the same vector; the 256-row visit quantum, captured tail, hydrated-prefix acknowledgement, acknowledgement batching and backpressure, OWED_MAX_EVENTS and every timeout, retry count and cooldown keep their current values.

Forbidden: widened or shortened timeouts, bounds, budgets, holds, retry counts or catch-up cadence; harness repair of product state; changes to the journey predicates or their bounds; tuning of the slot slicing machinery (it is carried unchanged by this unit and removed by its own unit).

Every source and proof change is verified on the exact candidate by a fresh independent verifier (note --verification ... --verifier subagent:<id> --verdict approve) before landing; reproducers are observed red on the sealed base before the candidate is credited.

Tests and the journey run on lab hosts through the local controller, never on the workstation; every run's complete evidence is brought back before the host environment is reused; a failed run stays recorded as failed and is never replayed to obtain a green.
